subject: How can i make my app run faster with shiny?

messages.author: 9e5b6647683ad4a8
messages.subject: How can i make my app run faster with shiny?
parts:
i have this code and i have to run it 15 times in my app which makes it really slow.I assume that i need some kind o f parallel processing package.Any suggestions?


library("SportsAnalytics")
library("archetypes")
library("RColorBrewer")
library("googleVis")
col_pal <- brewer.pal(7, "Set1")
col_black <- rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.2)
dat <- subset(DatabaseEuroleague,
                select = -c(FGPerc,TwoPPerc,ThreePPerc,FTPerc,TOT))

mat <- as.data.frame(subset(dat, select = -c(Year,Name,Team)))

MAT <- na.exclude(mat)
DAT <- na.exclude(dat)
set.seed(4321)
as <- stepArchetypes(MAT, k = 1:10)

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] How can i make my app run faster with shiny?
parts:
Unfortunately this is more of an R question than a shiny or a shinyapps.io question so it is probably best to post it on stack overflow instead. 
If the slowness is in the loading and manipulation of the data frame I would recommend you checkout the dplyr package. 
Unfortunately I have no idea how you could improve the performance of stepArchetypes.
